instruction: A candid medium studio photograph of two friends against a solid light blue background. On the left, the fair-skinned woman with long straight blonde hair (R1), wearing a grey t-shirt and blue jeans, smiles broadly while playfully touching the hair of the woman with curly brown hair (R2) on the right. The curly-haired woman (R2), dressed in a white off-the-shoulder top and blue jeans, laughs joyfully with her eyes closed. The scene is captured with bright, even studio lighting.
